issues.title_en: Lighter Inflation Data Eases Yields, Lifts Stocks
issues.current_state_en: Wholesale inflation printed lighter than expected on Aug 13, sending Treasury yields lower and US equities higher in the session.
issues.current_state_ko: 8월 13일 도매물가가 예상보다 낮게 나와 국채 금리가 하락하고 미국 주가가 상승했다.
issues.novelty_en: Fresh data gives Fed more time to defend its forecast; post-report rally in equities confirms transmission.
